name: syncexc
description: SyncExc — Multi-exchange cryptocurrency trading synchronization and automation platform
author: SyncExc

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=admin
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=admin
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules shared/node_modules server/node_modules client/node_modules admin/node_modules shared/dist server/dist client/dist admin/dist
